description: The Kansas Jayhawks (4-6) host the No. 10 BYU Cougars (8-2) at David Booth Kansas Memorial Stadium. Kansas broke a two-game skid with a 37-14 victory against West Virginia, while BYU enters with alternate win-loss records in their last five.
